title: FINES AND SURCHARGES FOR CLERICAL ERRORS, MISDECLARATION, MISCLASSIFICATION AND UNDERVALUATION
subject: Fines and surcharges for clerical errors, misdeclaration, misclassification and undervaluation
date_issued: DEC 20 2019 (approved by the Secretary of Finance on JAN 14 2020)
effectivity: Thirty (30) days from publication at the Official Gazette or a newspaper of national circulation

CAO No. 03-2019 Post Clearance and Prior Disclosure Program

ai.title: CAO 01-2020: Fines at Surcharges (Clerical Errors, Misdeclaration, Misclassification, Undervaluation)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Implementing rules ito ng Section 108 (Chapter 2, Title I) at Section 1400 (Chapter 1, Title XIV) ng CMTA: ang Php5,000.00 fine para sa clerical errors sa Goods Declaration, at ang 250% o 500% surcharge para sa Misdeclaration, Misclassification at Undervaluation.

🔍 Breakdown: Secs. 1–2: saklaw at layunin. Sec. 3: depinisyon (Declarant, Final Assessment, Fraud, Goods, Goods Declaration, Gross Negligence, Inadvertent Error, Lodgement, Misclassification, Misdeclaration, Seizure, Undervaluation). Sec. 4: 4.1 Php5,000.00 fine kada clerical error; 4.2 250% surcharge kapag 10% o higit ang discrepancy; 4.2.1 pitong instances; 4.2.2 documentary requirements; 4.2.3 500% surcharge kapag intentional o fraudulent, plus Seizure. Sec. 5: kailan walang surcharge. Sec. 6: prima facie evidence of Fraud (higit sa 30%). Sec. 7: Penal Provision. Sec. 8: ICT-enabled System. Secs. 9–12: review, repealing, separability, effectivity.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May tatlong level ng pananagutan: (1) maliit na clerical error = Php5,000.00 fine kada error; (2) maling declaration na may 10% o higit na discrepancy = 250% surcharge; (3) intentional o fraudulent = 500% surcharge plus Seizure.

📦 Halimbawa: Nag-declare ang importer ng 1,000 cartons pero 1,300 cartons ang nakita sa physical examination: Misdeclaration as to Quantity. Kung 10% o higit ang discrepancy sa duty at tax, 250% surcharge ang ipapataw (Sec. 4.2). Kung napatunayang intentional, halimbawa may isinumiteng false document, 500% surcharge na at may Seizure pa (Sec. 4.2.3).

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito? Para ma-discourage ang paulit-ulit na pagkakamali at fraud sa Goods Declaration, at para may malinaw na rules sa fines at surcharges.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 10% o higit ang threshold ng 250% surcharge; higit sa 30% ang prima facie evidence ng Fraud; Php5,000.00 kada clerical error; 15 araw para maging final ang assessment (Sec. 3.2). May exceptions sa Sec. 5, kabilang ang timely amendment bago ang Final Assessment.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: I-memorize ang mga numero: Php5,000.00 / 250% / 500% / 10% / 30% / 15 days; at ang mga sanggunian: Sec. 1113 ng CMTA (Seizure), Sec. 1401 (fines o penalties), Sec. 408 (amendment bago ang Final Assessment).

❓ Madalas Malito ang Students: Tanong: Pareho ba ang Misdeclaration at Misclassification? Sagot: Hindi. Misdeclaration = mali sa quantity, quality, description, weight o measurement. Misclassification = maling description o maling tariff heading/sub-heading. Undervaluation = mali o kulang ang declared value.

🔗 Related Topics: CMTA Secs. 108, 1400, 1401, 1113, 408; CAO 1-2019 (Post Clearance Audit); TCCP Sec. 3611 (b); CAO 01-2014 at CAO 06-2014 (amended o repealed).

Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: This Customs Administrative Order (CAO) implements Section 108, Chapter 2, Title I; Section 1400, Chapter 1, Title XIV; and other relevant provisions of Republic Act No. 10863, otherwise known as the Customs Modernization and Tariff Act (CMTA).

ai.title: Legal Basis ng CAO
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ipinapatupad ng CAO ang Section 108 (Chapter 2, Title I), Section 1400 (Chapter 1, Title XIV) at iba pang relevant provisions ng CMTA (RA 10863).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang batayan ng fines at surcharges para sa clerical errors at maling declaration.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ayon sa Sec. 2.2, ang Sec. 108 ay tungkol sa fine sa clerical errors; ang Sec. 1400 naman ang binabanggit sa surcharge (Sec. 4.2).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Introduction ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Legal Basis ng CAO. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: This CAO covers all Goods Declaration for exportation, or importation whether for consumption, warehousing or admission.

ai.title: Saklaw ng CAO
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sakop ang lahat ng Goods Declaration para sa exportation, o importation — consumption, warehousing o admission.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi lang import for consumption; pati export, warehousing at admission ay kasama.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kasama ang export Goods Declaration sa saklaw.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 1. Scope ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Saklaw ng CAO. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: To clarify the provisions of Sections 108 and 1400 of the CMTA;

ai.title: Objective: Linawin ang Secs. 108 at 1400
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Linawin ang provisions ng Sections 108 at 1400 ng CMTA.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mas detalyado ang CAO para hindi malabo ang pag-apply ng CMTA.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Objective: Linawin ang Secs. 108 at 1400. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: To impose fine(s) in case of clerical errors in accordance with the provisions under Section 108 of the CMTA; and

ai.title: Objective: Fine sa Clerical Errors
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Magpataw ng fine sa kaso ng clerical errors alinsunod sa Section 108 ng CMTA.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May multa kahit hindi fraud ang error.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang halaga ng fine ay nasa Sec. 4.1.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.2 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Objective: Fine sa Clerical Errors. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: To provide clear and concise rules and guidelines for the proper implementation of Sections 108 and 1400 of the CMTA.

ai.title: Objective: Malinaw na Rules
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Magbigay ng malinaw at concise na rules at guidelines para sa tamang implementasyon ng Sections 108 at 1400 ng CMTA.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Para pare-pareho ang pag-apply ng rules sa fines at surcharges.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.3 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Objective: Malinaw na Rules. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: For purposes of this CAO, the following terms are defined accordingly:

ai.title: Definition of Terms
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Panimula sa listahan ng mga depinisyon na gagamitin sa CAO.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May specific na kahulugan ang mga terms 'for purposes of this CAO' lang, kaya basahin nang eksakto ang wording.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3. Definition of Terms ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Definition of Terms. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Declarant — shall refer to the consignee or person authorized to dispose of the goods, who has lodged and filed the Goods Declaration with the Bureau.

ai.title: Definition: Declarant
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang consignee o taong authorized na mag-dispose ng goods, na nag-lodge at nag-file ng Goods Declaration sa Bureau.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Siya ang nasa likod ng declaration na sinusuri ng customs.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Hindi lang consignee ang Declarant; pati ang taong authorized na mag-dispose ng goods. Batayan: Sec. 106 ng CMTA.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.1 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Definition: Declarant. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Final Assessment — shall refer to an assessment which is deemed final fifteen (15) days after receipt of the notice of assessment by the importer or consignee without timely and legally instituted dispute and/or protest.

ai.title: Definition: Final Assessment
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Assessment na ituturing na final 15 araw matapos matanggap ng importer o consignee ang notice of assessment, kung walang timely at legally instituted na dispute at/o protest.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kapag lumipas ang 15 araw nang walang tamang protest o dispute, final na ang assessment.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Mahalaga ito sa Sec. 5.4: ang timely amendment ay dapat bago ang Final Assessment o examination. Batayan: Sec. 429 ng CMTA.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.2 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Definition: Final Assessment. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Fraud — shall refer to the commission or omission of any act resulting in material false statements such as, but not limited to, the submission of false or altered documents in connection with any importation, knowingly, voluntarily and intentionally done, to reduce the taxes and duties paid or to avoid compliance with government regulations related to the entry of Regulated, Prohibited or Restricted goods into Philippine customs territory through Misdeclaration, Misclassification or Undervaluation.

ai.title: Definition: Fraud
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Commission o omission ng act na nagreresulta sa material false statements — hal. pagsusumite ng false o altered documents — na knowingly, voluntarily at intentionally ginawa para bawasan ang taxes at duties o iwasan ang compliance sa regulations sa Regulated, Prohibited o Restricted goods, sa pamamagitan ng Misdeclaration, Misclassification o Undervaluation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Fraud = sinadyang pagkakamali, hindi simpleng mistake.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tatlong key words: 'knowingly, voluntarily and intentionally'. Mahalaga ito sa 500% surcharge (Sec. 4.2.3) at sa prima facie rule (Sec. 6). Batayan: CAO 1-2019 Sec. 3.3.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.3 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Definition: Fraud. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Goods — shall refer to articles, wares, merchandise and any other items which may include Philippine and foreign notes and coins imported or exported.

ai.title: Definition: Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Articles, wares, merchandise at iba pang items na imported o exported, na maaaring kabilang ang Philippine at foreign notes at coins.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pati pera (notes at coins) ay maaaring ituring na Goods dito.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Detalyeng madalas hindi napapansin: kasama ang Philippine at foreign notes at coins.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.4 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Definition: Goods. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Goods Declaration — shall refer to a statement made in the manner prescribed by the Bureau and other appropriate agencies, by which the persons concerned indicate the procedure to be observed in the application for the entry or admission of imported Goods and the particulars of which the customs administration shall require.

ai.title: Definition: Goods Declaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Statement na ginawa sa paraang itinakda ng Bureau at ibang appropriate agencies, kung saan ipinapahiwatig ng concerned persons ang procedure sa application for entry o admission ng imported Goods at ang particulars na hinihingi ng customs.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang main document na sinusuri para sa errors at misdeclaration.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Dito ina-apply ang Php5,000 fine kada clerical error (Sec. 4.1). Batayan: Sec. 102 (y) ng CMTA.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.5 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Definition: Goods Declaration. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Gross Negligence — shall refer to act or acts of omission or commission done with actual knowledge or wanton disregard of the relevant facts and with indifference to or disregard for offender's obligation under the statute.

ai.title: Definition: Gross Negligence
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Act o omission na ginawa nang may actual knowledge o wanton disregard sa relevant facts at may indifference sa obligasyon ng offender sa ilalim ng statute.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi lang pagkakamali: alam mo ang facts pero binalewala mo.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kapag gross negligence ang sanhi, hindi na 'clerical' ang error (Sec. 4.1.1). Batayan: Sec. 3611 (b) ng TCCP.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.6 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Definition: Gross Negligence. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Inadvertent Error — shall refer to a mechanical, electronic or clerical error committed unintentionally by the Declarant which occurred notwithstanding the maintenance of internal controls necessary to avoid such errors.

ai.title: Definition: Inadvertent Error
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Mechanical, electronic o clerical error na unintentional na nagawa ng Declarant sa kabila ng internal controls na pinapanatili para maiwasan ito.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Aksidenteng mali kahit may maayos na controls.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Key words: 'unintentionally' at 'notwithstanding the maintenance of internal controls'. Batayan: CAO 1-2019 Sec. 3.6.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.7 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Definition: Inadvertent Error. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Lodgement — shall refer to the electronic registration of a Goods Declaration with the Bureau.

ai.title: Definition: Lodgement
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Electronic registration ng Goods Declaration sa Bureau.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kapag na-register na electronically sa Bureau, na-'lodge' na ang declaration.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang clerical errors ay tinutukoy 'upon the Lodgement' (Sec. 4.1).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.8 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Definition: Lodgement. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Misclassification — shall refer to the use of insufficient or wrong description of the goods or the use of erroneous tariff heading/s and sub-heading/s resulting in deficiency between the duty and tax that should have been paid and the duty and tax actually paid; and/or to avoid compliance with government regulations related to the entry of Regulated, Prohibited or Restricted goods into Philippine Customs territory.

ai.title: Definition: Misclassification
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Paggamit ng kulang o maling description ng goods, o ng maling tariff heading/s at sub-heading/s na nagresulta sa kulang na duty at tax; at/o para iwasan ang compliance sa regulations sa Regulated, Prohibited o Restricted goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mali ang description o classification kaya mababa ang binayarang duty at tax.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kasama ito sa 250% instances (Sec. 4.2.1.g). Batayan: CAO 1-2019 Sec. 3.8.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.9 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Definition: Misclassification. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Misdeclaration — shall refer to a false, untruthful, erroneous or inaccurate declaration as to quantity, quality, description, weight or measurement of the goods resulting in deficiency between the duty and tax that should have been paid and the duty and tax actually paid; and/or to avoid compliance with government regulations related to the entry of Regulated, Prohibited or Restricted goods into Philippine customs territory.

ai.title: Definition: Misdeclaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Maling, hindi totoo, erroneous o inaccurate na declaration ng quantity, quality, description, weight o measurement ng goods na nagresulta sa kulang na duty at tax; at/o para iwasan ang compliance sa regulations sa Regulated, Prohibited o Restricted goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May limang klase ng Misdeclaration: quantity, quality, description, weight at measurement.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang resulta ng physical examination ang ikinukumpara sa Goods Declaration. Batayan: CAO 1-2019 Sec. 3.9.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.10 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Definition: Misdeclaration. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: There is Misdeclaration as to the Quantity of Goods when there is a difference in the number of the Goods as declared in the Goods Declaration and the quantity as found after physical examination of the Goods.

ai.title: Misdeclaration as to Quantity
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: May Misdeclaration as to Quantity kapag may difference sa bilang ng Goods ayon sa Goods Declaration at sa quantity na nakita after physical examination.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Halimbawa: declared 1,000 pcs pero 1,200 pcs ang aktwal na nakita.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang karagdagang talata kaugnay ng Sec. 3.10 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Misdeclaration as to Quantity. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: There is Misdeclaration as to the Quality of Goods when there is a difference in the characteristics of the Goods as declared in the Goods Declaration and the quality as found after physical examination of the Goods (e.g. declared as USED but found out as BRAND NEW or declared as off-quality, remnants fabrics but found as whole, first class, best quality fabrics, among others).

ai.title: Misdeclaration as to Quality
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: May Misdeclaration as to Quality kapag may difference sa characteristics ng Goods ayon sa declaration at sa quality na nakita after physical examination.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mga halimbawa sa text: declared as USED pero BRAND NEW; o declared as off-quality, remnants fabrics pero whole, first class, best quality fabrics.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang karagdagang talata kaugnay ng Sec. 3.10 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Misdeclaration as to Quality. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: There is Misdeclaration as to Description of Goods when there is a difference in the descriptive nature and identity of the Goods as declared in the Goods Declaration and the description as found after physical examination of the Goods (e.g. product code, item code, make, model, series, displacement, version, among others).

ai.title: Misdeclaration as to Description
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: May Misdeclaration as to Description kapag may difference sa descriptive nature at identity ng Goods ayon sa declaration at sa description na nakita after physical examination.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mga halimbawa sa text: product code, item code, make, model, series, displacement, version.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang karagdagang talata kaugnay ng Sec. 3.10 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Misdeclaration as to Description. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: There is Misdeclaration as to the Weight of Goods when there is a discrepancy in the actual weight as declared in the Goods Declaration and the weight as found after physical examination and weighing of the Goods.

ai.title: Misdeclaration as to Weight
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: May Misdeclaration as to Weight kapag may discrepancy sa actual weight na declared at sa weight na nakita after physical examination at weighing.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Iba ang timbang sa papel kumpara sa aktwal na timbang.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang karagdagang talata kaugnay ng Sec. 3.10 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Misdeclaration as to Weight. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: There is Misdeclaration as to the Measurement of Goods when there is a difference in the size, length, width, height or volume of the Goods as declared in the Goods Declaration and the measurement as found after physical examination of the Goods.

ai.title: Misdeclaration as to Measurement
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: May Misdeclaration as to Measurement kapag may difference sa size, length, width, height o volume ng Goods ayon sa declaration at sa measurement na nakita after physical examination.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Iba ang sukat sa papel kumpara sa aktwal na sukat.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang karagdagang talata kaugnay ng Sec. 3.10 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Misdeclaration as to Measurement. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Seizure — shall refer to the actual or constructive taking or placing under custody the Goods, things or chattels by virtue of a Warrant of Seizure and Detention issued by the District Collector of Customs for violation of the CMTA and other related laws.

ai.title: Definition: Seizure
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Actual o constructive na pagkuha o paglalagay sa custody ng Goods, things o chattels sa bisa ng Warrant of Seizure and Detention na inilabas ng District Collector of Customs para sa violation ng CMTA at iba pang related laws.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hawak na ng customs ang goods dahil may warrant.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Warrant of Seizure and Detention mula sa District Collector ang basehan. Kaugnay ng Secs. 4.2.3 at 6.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.11 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Definition: Seizure. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Undervaluation — shall refer to situation when the declared value fails to disclose in full the price actually paid or payable; or any dutiable adjustment to the price actually paid or payable; or when an incorrect valuation method is used; or the valuation rules are not properly observed; resulting in a discrepancy in duty and tax to be paid between what is legally determined as the correct value against the declared value.

ai.title: Definition: Undervaluation
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sitwasyon kung saan ang declared value ay hindi buo ang price actually paid o payable; o may dutiable adjustment na hindi isinama; o mali ang valuation method; o hindi nasunod ang valuation rules — na nagresulta sa discrepancy sa duty at tax.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Masyadong mababa ang idineklarang halaga kaya kulang ang duty at tax.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Apat na paraan: kulang ang price na idineklara, hindi isinama ang dutiable adjustment, maling valuation method, o hindi nasunod ang valuation rules. Batayan: CAO 1-2019 Sec. 3.16.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.12 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Definition: Undervaluation. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Fine(s) for Clerical Error(s) in Goods Declaration. To discourage repetition, the concerned District Collector, through the Deputy Collector for Assessment, shall, in addition to the assessed duties, taxes, fees, fines or surcharges due, collect a fine of Five Thousand Pesos (Php5,000.00) for every clerical error determined to have been committed in the covering Goods Declaration upon the Lodgement thereof.

ai.title: Fine sa Clerical Errors
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang District Collector, sa pamamagitan ng Deputy Collector for Assessment, ay maniningil ng Php5,000.00 na fine para sa bawat clerical error sa covering Goods Declaration pagka-lodge nito, bukod pa sa assessed duties, taxes, fees, fines o surcharges.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Isang clerical error, isang Php5,000.00 na fine. Kung tatlong clerical errors, tatlong beses ang fine.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Layunin: 'to discourage repetition'. Dagdag ito sa ibang bayarin. Ang kumukolekta ay ang District Collector via Deputy Collector for Assessment.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.1 ng CAO No. 01-2020 tungkol sa Fine sa Clerical Errors. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Errors may be clerical when the same is inadvertent which may include misspelling and/or incorrect input of data while drafting, copying or transposing a document such as consignee(s)' name, importing vessel or aircraft, port of departure, port of destination and date of arrival, the number and/or marks of packages, or the quantity, the nature and correct commodity description of the Goods contained therein, its value as set forth in a proper invoice, packing list and such other information as may be required by rules and regulations; provided, that it is not attendant with Fraud and not due to Gross Negligence.

ai.title: Kailan Clerical ang Error
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Clerical ang error kapag inadvertent — hal. misspelling o maling input ng data habang nagda-draft, nagkokopya o nagta-transpose ng dokumento, gaya ng pangalan ng consignee, importing vessel o aircraft, port of departure, port of destination, date of arrival, number o marks ng packages, quantity, nature at commodity description ng Goods, at value sa proper invoice o packing list — basta hindi attendant sa Fraud at hindi dahil sa Gross Negligence.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Clerical = aksidenteng typo o mali sa pagkopya, walang bad faith at hindi pabaya.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Dalawang kondisyon para maging clerical: (1) hindi attendant sa Fraud at (2) hindi dahil sa Gross Negligence.
